description: Key list of the sharp certificate sharp_klp5.cert.npz for sigma(K_5^(4)) = 31/64 (complement form: Turan (n,5,4)-systems, p = 5, lambda = 1, N = 7). One entry per Gram key k: s, m, type_index, sigma (colex mask on [s]), n_flags, flags (colex masks on [m], roots 0..s-1), in the index order of the matrices of the .npz. Taken unchanged from certificates/K5_4/lpcg_p5_conv_full.cert.json (the same flag model), as in the independent review of this certificate.
format: Q_k = W_k^T W_k / 2^(2 kb) + B_k^T X_k B_k with X_k = X_times_q / q; the integer Gram matrix is D Q_k = q W_k^T W_k + 2^(2 kb) B_k^T X_times_q B_k with D = 2^(2 kb) q. npz fields: kb (int), q and D (decimal strings), W{k} (decimal strings, integer rows; an empty array means no rows), B{k} (int64, for the keys listed in corr), corr (JSON list of {key, X_times_q, ...}), eps (the target diagonal 2^-20 of X). The objective on a 7-vertex 4-graph H is kappa(H) = (24 e(H) - P(H))/420, P(H) = sum over 3-sets T of c_T (c_T - 1), c_T = #{x outside T: T + x in H}; the value is min over admissible H of kappa(H) - sum_k c_{Q_k}(H), with c_Q as in Definition cert of the paper.
